events.title: The Beatles' "White Album" Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their ninth studio album, "The Beatles," commonly known as the "White Album," on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles unleashed their sprawling double album, 'The White Album'. Still sounds immense.

events.title: Freddie Mercury would have been 80
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, the world lost legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who left us 35 years ago today. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' "Rubber Soul" Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking sixth studio album, "Rubber Soul," on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul
angles.copy: It's 61 years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that changed everything.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The world tragically lost music icon John Lennon on this day in 1980.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86 this year. His legacy of peace and incredible music lives on.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Music legend David Bowie was born on this day in 1947.

angles.name: David Bowie Birthday
angles.copy: Celebrating the life and artistry of David Bowie, who would have turned 80 today. A true innovator.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, was born on this day in 1935.

angles.name: Elvis Presley Birthday
angles.copy: Happy heavenly birthday to the King, Elvis Presley, who would have been 92 today. Still shaking up the airwaves.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page was born on this day in 1944.

angles.name: Jimmy Page Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the iconic Jimmy Page. Still inspiring guitarists everywhere.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Rock and pop superstar Rod Stewart celebrates his birthday on this day, born in 1945.

angles.name: Rod Stewart Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart! Still got that unmistakable voice.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Suggs, real name Graham McPherson, was born on this day in 1961.

angles.name: Suggs Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the legendary Suggs from Madness! Our house, in the middle of our street.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Paul Young, known for hits like "Wherever I Lay My Hat," was born on this day in 1956.

angles.name: Paul Young Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! Still the voice of a generation.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Country music icon Dolly Parton celebrates her birthday on this day, born in 1946.

angles.name: Dolly Parton Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the legendary Dolly Parton! Still working 9 to 5 and beyond.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and singer-songwriter Gary Barlow was born on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Gary Barlow Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Take That's Gary Barlow! Still writing the hits.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his 80s hits, was born on this day in 1950.

angles.name: Billy Ocean Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the fantastic Billy Ocean! Get outta my dreams, get into my car.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame Anniversary
events.blurb: The first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony took place on this day in 1986, honouring pioneers like Elvis Presley and Chuck Berry.

angles.name: Rock Hall of Fame
angles.copy: 38 years ago, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its first induction. Who's your all-time favourite inductee?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his birthday on this day, born in 1972.

angles.name: Mark Owen Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! Still shining after all these years.

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their iconic final live performance, the Apple Corps rooftop concert, on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Beatles Rooftop
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles played their legendary rooftop concert. What a way to go out.

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Genesis drummer and solo superstar Phil Collins was born on this day in 1951.

angles.name: Phil Collins Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the legendary Phil Collins! Still in the air tonight.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: Renowned British actor Hugh Grant was born on this day in 1960.

angles.name: Hugh Grant Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to the charming Hugh Grant! Still one of Britain's favourite leading men.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar Justin Timberlake celebrates his birthday on this day, born in 1981.

angles.name: Justin Timberlake Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! Bringing SexyBack since day one.

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Sir David Jason, famous for his roles in Only Fools and Horses and A Touch of Frost, was born on this day in 1940.

angles.name: David Jason Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason! Lovely jubbly.

events.title: The Day The Music Died Anniversary
events.blurb: On this tragic day in 1959, Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper died in a plane crash, an event known as "The Day The Music Died."

angles.name: Day Music Died
angles.copy: Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper, who we lost on 'The Day The Music Died' 68 years ago. Their music lives on.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Rick Astley, known for his 80s hits and viral fame, was born on this day in 1966.

angles.name: Rick Astley Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to the never-going-to-give-you-up Rick Astley! Still got the moves.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Reggae icon Bob Marley was born on this day in 1945.

angles.name: Bob Marley Birthday
angles.copy: Celebrating the life and legacy of Bob Marley, who would have turned 82 today. One love, one heart.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Legendary singer-songwriter Carole King was born on this day in 1942.

angles.name: Carole King Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 85th birthday to the incredible Carole King! Still a natural woman of song.

events.title: Whitney Houston would have been 64
events.blurb: On this day in 2012, the world mourned the loss of the incomparable Whitney Houston.

angles.name: Whitney Houston Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the voice of a generation, Whitney Houston, who we lost 15 years ago today. Always loved.

events.title: Take That Split Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, Take That announced their split, breaking hearts across the nation.

angles.name: Take That Split
angles.copy: 31 years ago, Take That broke up and the world collectively cried. Thankfully, they're back for good!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: UB40 frontman Ali Campbell was born on this day in 1959.

angles.name: Ali Campbell Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 68th birthday to UB40's Ali Campbell! Still making us red, red wine.

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Global pop superstar Ed Sheeran celebrates his birthday on this day, born in 1991.

angles.name: Ed Sheeran Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 36th birthday to the one and only Ed Sheeran! Still writing those perfect songs.
